g.text: Idempotency Deep Dive — Ticketing System (Orders + Notifications)
3 Views + Race Scenarios | Light background | Code refs: Method + File Path
② Guard: existing.Status != Cancelled → return existing
③ Unique Index catches concurrent create
③ State guard throws if not Pending
• IPN race: loser gets concurrency exception
⚡ RACE CONDITION SCENARIOS (Explicit Thread A vs Thread B)
• Guarded state machine (Layer 2) catches it: Status check BEFORE MarkAsPaid
• If both threads read Pending simultaneously → Layer 3 (xmin rowversion) catches at DB
• First commit updates xmin → second gets concurrency exception
• VNPay retries → second IPN sees Paid status → early return
• Layer 1 (Idempotency Key) catches it BEFORE DB: GetByReservationIdAsync() returns existing
• If both hit DB simultaneously → Layer 3 (UNIQUE INDEX on ReservationId) catches at INSERT
• CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:68-72 catches failure, reads winner, returns it
RACE 3: Duplicate EventId (Outbox retries + Inbox dedupe)
• Layer 1 (EventId) + Layer 3 (UNIQUE INDEX on EventId) dual protection
• If both pass pre-check → UNIQUE INDEX catches at commit
• Loser commit fails → PrepareIncomingAsync returns IsNew=false
• Endpoint returns Duplicated=true → Outbox marks Processed
